decisions.decision: Edit workshop-plan/build/review_hub.py line 367 (flow d-prove). Look in app/scripts/review-hub-data.ts and DAY_STEPS in app/src/lib/curriculum.ts for the step that now holds 'the number that proves it worked'. If that step still exists under a new id, point d-prove at that onboarding/<id>. If it does not, delete the d-prove node and renumber d-ship to '5 · Ship'. Do not create a new card just to fill the slot. Then run python3 workshop-plan/build/review_hub.py until it prints no PROBLEMS. That regenerates workshop-plan/index.html and live/index.html. Run node app/scripts/probe-review-hub.mjs, commit to main and publish the hub to the mirror. Log the fix on T-280 and T-150, then move T-280 to review for Nelbin and Adi.
decisions.why: T-280 pass 2 confirmed that onboarding/d1-prove is missing from workshop-cards.ts, and grep finds no prove card there. Fixing or dropping a flow step is an edit to our own generated hub. T-150 needs this fix before it can be signed off.
